subject: Insurance
title: Black Swan Events
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Black Swan Events.

hook.text: Nassim Taleb coined 'Black Swan' for events that are rare, unpredictable, and devastating.

buildup.text: Models can't predict Black Swans because they lie outside historical experience.

discovery.text: Taleb argues that instead of predicting Black Swans, you should build systems that survive them.

twist.text: After every Black Swan, people claim it was obvious in hindsight.

climax.text: Black Swans define the limits of insurance. Some events can't be modeled, priced, or predicted.

punchline.text: Rare, unpredictable, devastating. Black Swans break every insurance model.

quiz.question: What is a Black Swan event?
options: A rare, unpredictable event with massive impact
